claim: With pre-scaling, also called pre-warming, you can set minimum supported limits for an ElastiCache serverless cache, for ECPUs per second or data storage. This can be useful in preparation for anticipated scaling events.

evidence.quote: With pre-scaling, also called pre-warming, you can set minimum supported limits for your ElastiCache cache. You can set these minimums for ElastiCache Processing Units (ECPUs) per second or data storage. This can be useful in preparation for anticipated scaling events.
